// how the experience comes together

01

The world it connects

Company plans, meeting context, the deal pipeline, and agent activity give work questions somewhere concrete to go.

02

The way it feels

A spare interface, the hev orange accent, and short spoken answers suit a quick check between tasks. The transcript is there when you want to inspect what happened.

03

The dots connection

hev dot helped establish the voice loop that became dots: a conversation calls tools, tool results ground the answer, and useful details can appear on screen. The company-specific knowledge stays with this dot.

The experience starts with the working day. Its tools and personality follow from that.
